verified_mechanisms: versioned refusal-reason taxonomy maps stable reason codes to structured categories
unknown reason taxonomy cannot silently satisfy a golden refusal
bounded deterministic argument mutation corpus exercises mutation-stable refusal cases
mutation results bind mutation identity and argument digest
cross-version comparison classifies refusal loss, refusal gain, reason drift, category drift, both-allowed drift, and unchanged behavior
duplicate golden case identifiers fail closed
boundaries: mutation fuzz is bounded deterministic regression coverage, not exhaustive fuzzing
only cases explicitly marked mutation-stable are required to preserve their refusal reason across mutations
the harness evaluates supplied decision functions and supplied golden cases; it does not prove a production model policy
